topic: CUDA event timing, with a handout at a fixed path.
grill: I want a handout I can keep, at professor-lessons/handout-missing/handout.md.
Then teach me the timing boundary.
I can compute GFLOP/s but I do not trust my timings.

facts.claim: The host launches kernels asynchronously, so the launch returns before the kernel finishes.
A CUDA event is recorded in a stream and timestamped when the stream reaches it.
A host timer measures the enqueue cost, because the kernel runs later; only an in-stream event measures device progress.
facts.wrong: A host wall-clock timer around the launch measures how long the kernel ran on the device.
